title: Accounts Assistant
salary_text: £27000 - £30000 per year (Free parking, pension. Temporary to)
description:
Accounts Assistant Temporary to Permanent opportunity in Mid Devon

Salary £27k-£30k Depending on experience

Role Overview

We are seeking a detail oriented and proactive Accounts Assistant to join our clients finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious individual looking to develop their career within a dynamic, fast-paced business. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the day to day financial operations of the company, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance at all times. The role requires excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively across teams.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and oversee credit control, including debt chasing and query resolution.
- Process and input purchase invoices accurately and efficiently.
- Carry out bank reconciliations and maintain accurate cash records.
- Maintain and manage the debtor ledger.
- Support month-end procedures, reconciliations, and reporting.
- Use Excel and accounting software to track, analyse, and update financial data.
- Ensure accurate filing and maintenance of financial documentation.
- Provide ad hoc support to the finance team and wider business as required.

Experience & Skills
- Experience in bookkeeping or accounts is essential.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
- Good communication skills (written and verbal) with confidence to liaise with colleagues, clients, and external stakeholders.
- Proactive problem-solver with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Previous experience using accounting software and MS Office (especially Excel).

Benefits
- Free on-site parking
- Supportive and collaborative working environment

title: Accounts Payable Assistant
description:
As an Accounts Payable Assistant in Park Royal, you will manage day-to-day supplier invoice processing for a Transport & Distribution business, helping the finance function keep records accurate and payments on track. You will work within the Accounting & Finance department to maintain clear, reliable accounts payable information.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Transport & Distribution industry in Park Royal.

Description
- Process supplier invoices accurately and ensure records are complete and up to date.
- Check invoice details against available documentation to help maintain accurate payment records.
- Maintain accounts payable files and records in an organised, accessible format.
- Respond to supplier queries and provide clear updates on invoice information.
- Work with colleagues in Accounting & Finance to resolve invoice discrepancies promptly.
- Prepare invoice information for payment processing and keep supporting documents in order.
- Review accounts payable data and flag missing or unclear information for resolution.

Profile

A successful Accounts Payable Assistant should have:
- Experience processing and maintaining supplier invoices.
- A good understanding of accounts payable processes and accurate record keeping.
- The ability to check financial information carefully and identify discrepancies.
- Confidence responding to supplier queries in a clear and professional way.
- Strong organisational skills when managing invoices and supporting documentation.
- The ability to work effectively with colleagues in an Accounting & Finance team.

Job Offer
- Permanent Accounts Payable Assistant position based in Park Royal.
- Salary of £30,000 to £35,000, dependent on the level of experience.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

description:

About You

We are looking for someone who:
- Has previous experience in Finance Administration, Purchase Ledger or a similar role.
- Is confident processing invoices and dealing with supplier queries.
- Has excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- Is comfortable using computerised finance systems and Microsoft Office.
- Has good written and verbal communication skills.
- Can work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team.
- Is available to start ASAP.
- Previous experience with SAP or similar finance systems would be advantageous.

What's on Offer
- £16 £18 per hour, depending on experience.
- Full-time hours, ideally 08 00.
- Initial 6 8 week temporary assignment.
- Potential for the assignment to be extended.
- Immediate start available.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Are you an experienced payroll professional who enjoys working closely with clients and taking ownership of your work?

We're looking for a Payroll Administrator to join a friendly and collaborative payroll team, delivering accurate, reliable and responsive payroll services to a diverse portfolio of businesses.

This is a client-facing role where you'll have the opportunity to build strong relationships, manage your own portfolio and play an important part in ensuring payrolls are processed accurately and on time.

The Role

As a Payroll Administrator, you'll take responsibility for a portfolio of clients, working closely with them to deliver a high-quality payroll service while supporting the wider team.

What you'll be doing
- Processing a variety of client payrolls as part of a collaborative payroll team
- Acting as the primary point of contact for an allocated portfolio of clients
- Managing client payrolls from start to finish, ensuring accuracy and compliance
- Supporting the onboarding of new clients and payrolls, ensuring data is complete and accurate
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency and enhance the client experience
- Building and maintaining strong, professional client relationships
- Responding to payroll queries accurately, professionally and within agreed timescales
- Keeping up to date with changes in payroll legislation and ensuring these are correctly applied
- Liaising with HMRC regarding employer payments and payroll-related matters
- Ensuring payroll deadlines are consistently met
- Working collaboratively with colleagues and providing support where required

About You

You'll be an organised and detail-focused payroll professional who takes pride in delivering an accurate and dependable service.

You'll ideally have:
- Strong knowledge and practical experience of UK payroll legislation
- Experience managing a portfolio of clients or multiple payrolls
- A proven track record of delivering excellent client service
- Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to your work
- Confident written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to build positive working relationships with a wide range of clients
- The ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a wider team
- Excellent organisation and time-management skills, with the ability to work to strict deadlines
- Good numerical and analytical skills
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook
- A professional, courteous and solutions-focused approach

What's on Offer?

You'll join an organisation that values its people and provides a supportive environment in which to develop your career.

Alongside a competitive salary, you'll have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing.

Financial wellbeing
- Employer-supported pension scheme
- Group life assurance
- Income protection
- Health cash plan, including support for eligible dependants

Mental wellbeing
- Confidential counselling and emotional support
- Virtual GP and second-opinion services
- Access to trained Mental Health First Aiders
- A range of resources to support your overall wellbeing

Physical wellbeing
- Cycle to work scheme
- Access to discounted gym, pool and fitness memberships
- Digital health and wellbeing resources
- Support and resources around menopause and women's health

Additional benefits
- Family-friendly benefits and enhanced family leave
- The opportunity to purchase additional annual leave
- Paid volunteering day each year
- Electric vehicle lease scheme, subject to eligibility
- Recognition of key career and family milestones
- Regular expert-led wellbeing webinars
- Access to charitable support for colleagues experiencing financial hardship

Why Join?

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established and forward-thinking professional services organisation where people are encouraged to develop, collaborate and make a genuine contribution.

You'll work alongside experienced payroll professionals, supporting a varied client base and gaining exposure to a broad range of payroll requirements.

The organisation offers a flexible approach to hybrid working, alongside a strong focus on learning, development, wellbeing and creating an inclusive working environment where people can be themselves.

If you're an experienced payroll professional looking for a role where client relationships, technical expertise and quality service are equally important, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more.
